label: Labour-migration evidence
text: The Market Intelligence Research Institute (ИПИ) analysis published 29 Oct finds no clear displacement of Bulgarian workers and no downward wage pressure from third-country hiring: about 29,000 third-country nationals held a work-purpose residence permit at end-2025 (almost 5× the 2020 level) but remain under 2% of 2.9mln employed, while NSI projects the working-age population to fall from ~3.9mln now to 3.1mln by 2050.
